g.text: MCA Minor Project Database Architecture & Entity-Relationship Model
ACADEMIC EXTENDED CHEN'S NOTATION (BLACK & WHITE EDITION)
KEY & NOTATION LEGEND (कुंजी एवं संकेत विवरण)
[FK] Foreign Key: Referential Link to Parent Table (Dashed)
[UK] Unique / Alternate Key: Candidate Key (Unique constraint)
[COMP] Composite Attribute: Groups related atomic fields
Course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) Minor Project
Tech Stack: Python 3.12 | Django 6.0 | SQLite / PostgreSQL
Database Design: Third Normal Form (3NF) | 10 Entities
Referential Integrity: ON DELETE CASCADE / SET_NULL
